Owner rulings 2026-09-18 on the D1A plan (revision 4):
A: ADR 0007 migration step 2's research gate is adjusted -- "we're developing software. build first, then researchers ask questions." The research-question half is removed; the engineering reason (do not generalise an unvalidated seam unseen) is answered by S0's text parity pins. S1 writes the amendment.
C: approved -- split into D1A-types (this bead) and D1A-film; design section 2; slices S0,S1,S2,S3,S4a,S4b,S4c.
D: approved -- D1 one bundle per model with composed multi-part films; D2 proposal surface outside the bundle, bound by checksum and receipt.
E: open (whether 1.0 ships film recall end to end or film-capable signatures only).
Revision 4 still owes a cold review before S2.
